Cause: a small render bug at src/render/renderer.ts:875, 'a.culled = lod === 2 && a.leaving < 0', which exempted bodies in their 0.6 s leave from culling. Diagnostic run _harness/_reports/gfx_ovr1.log reproduced the failure and showed shieldwick id 67, alive false, state dead, leaving 0.0167, 87.5 m from the focus: it died on that exact frame. That is why the fail depended on the game moment. Off screen its clip is held anyway, so the draw bought nothing. Fix: 'a.culled = lod === 2'; update() still ticks the leave and recullActors restores it if the camera arrives. The check is unchanged; the report gained offscreenInfo.
